mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batcheval_offline_job_cell (offline_job_id, task_key, prompt, conversation_key, turn_index, `status`) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{cell.taskKey}, #{cell.prompt}, #{cell.conversationKey}, #{cell.turnIndex}, #{cell.status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_key, prompt, conversation_key, turn_index, `status`, agentk_session_id, agentk_run_id, pipeline_exec_id, metrics_json, output_uris, error_message, started_at, finished_at FROM batcheval_offline_job_cell WHERE offline_job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT trace_json FROM batcheval_offline_job_cell WHERE task_key = #{taskKey} AND offline_job_id = ( SELECT id FROM batcheval_offline_job WHERE biz_id = #{bizId} LIMIT 1 ) LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE batcheval_offline_job_cell SET `status` = #{cell.status}, agentk_session_id = #{cell.agentkSessionId}, agentk_run_id = #{cell.agentkRunId}, pipeline_exec_id = #{cell.pipelineExecId}, metrics_json = #{cell.metricsJson}, output_uris = #{cell.outputUris}, trace_json = #{cell.traceJson}, error_message = #{cell.error}, started_at = #{cell.startedAt}, finished_at = #{cell.finishedAt} WHERE task_key = #{cell.taskKey} AND offline_job_id = ( SELECT id FROM batcheval_offline_job WHERE biz_id = #{bizId} LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM batcheval_offline_job_cell WHERE (#{agentkSessionId} IS NOT NULL AND #{agentkSessionId} <> '' AND agentk_session_id = #{agentkSessionId}) OR (#{agentkRunId} IS NOT NULL AND #{agentkRunId} <> '' AND (agentk_run_id = #{agentkRunId} OR pipeline_exec_id = #{agentkRunId}))
